OWNERSHIP AMENDED by ADR-0351: cross-cell rebalance is owned by the cell-rebalancer µservice (NOT 'composed across tenancy + observability'), cell lifecycle by the cell-lifecycle µservice, and within-cell hot-split/cold-merge sharding by the oya-shuffle-sharding crate.
